contract.purpose: Strengthen MyGRACE lint so managed files across src, dashboard, docs, and release surfaces cannot drift from contract rules.
contract.scope: Managed-file discovery, MODULE_CONTRACT/MODULE_MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY enforcement, semantic block pairing, and negative drift tests.

invariants.invariant-1: Every graph-index PATH that points to an existing managed file is linted.
invariants.invariant-2: Managed runtime and release files require MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and CHANGE_SUMMARY.
invariants.invariant-3: Semantic block START/END tags are paired by name, not only by count.

evidence.command-1: rtk npm test -- tests/mygrace-governance-lint.test.ts tests/mygrace-docs.test.ts tests/mygrace-cli-adapter.test.ts
